column6: A man cooking in his own kitchen with his back half turned; nothing is being performed to the lens.
Containers lined up on a counter; the sell is a Sunday habit, not a product feature.
A streamlined prep system is aimed at someone who already owns the pans and wants the set finished.
A set on white with no copy; the only decision being served is which colour.
A single pan in a different colourway; the feed is being covered rather than an argument made.
Navy this time; three near-identical tiles running the same week is a colour test, not a campaign.

column2: The Sceptic Who Wants A Diagram
column6: Isn't stainless steel hard to cook on is his real objection; not if your pan is built right moves the fault.
A long unedited caption about harsh chemicals and kids' plates; the length is what makes it read as a real review.
Smell like a spa is the promise; the cleaning product is being sold as an atmosphere.
Thinking about trying is written as a question; she is curious and has not yet been given a reason to switch.
A receipt with two lines struck through to zero; the maths is laid out so she does not have to do it.
A search bar typing microplastics, forever chemicals, alkyl ethoxylate; the ad is impersonating her own browser history.
A hand-drawn Venn diagram; the informality makes the chemistry feel like advice rather than marketing.
The same receipt with the laundry line swapped; the format is the campaign and the SKU is the variable.
A TIME100 list screenshot; the institution is being borrowed to certify a claim about microplastics.
Make the switch is the call to action; the three ticks are all things the incumbent contains.
One tablet does it all with four icons under it; she is trying to retire a shelf of bottles.
Frames held up to a face rather than photographed alone; the only question is how they look on.
Someone on a bike outside an ordinary house; the glasses are part of how a person is read at a distance.
Shot from the ground looking up; the sunglasses are styling a posture, not solving a vision problem.
